title: Fee Age Addition on the Early-Closure Late-Fee Relief - Credit Builder Accounts
content:
The relief share of the early-closure late-fee relief on a Credit Builder account grows when the late fee it applies to, the account's most recent late fee, is recent.

## Fee age bands

When the late fee was charged 15 or fewer calendar days before today (today less the fee's date, so a fee charged today is 0 days old), the prompt addition is added; when 16 to 45 days before, the recent addition; when longer ago, nothing is added for the fee's age.

| Age of the late fee (today less its date) | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 15 days | prompt addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| 16 to 45 days | recent addition: 0.02 (2 percentage points) |
| 46 days or more | nothing |

## Band edges (hypothetical dates)

| Late fee dated | Today | Age | Addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 16 April | 15 | prompt |
| 1 April | 17 April | 16 | recent |
| 1 April | 16 May | 45 | recent |
| 1 April | 17 May | 46 | nothing |
